svg.title: One stroke shuts one gate and opens the other
svg.desc: A channel forks at a post. Two leaves fixed square to each other on the post keep both mouths: the long one, glowing magenta, stands across the main run, where wide crates wait in line; the short one has swung out of the side mouth, and narrow teal crates pass it, round a bend, to a landing. At the far end of the main run a dashed outline stays empty.
